title: Shoppers Stop turns profitable in Q2 FY27 as consolidated revenue rises 7 per cent to Rs 1,618 crore
summary: The department store business recorded sales of Rs 1,302 crore, with festive-adjusted like-for-like growth of 7 per cent. The beauty segment grew 18 per cent to Rs 367 crore, led by a 35 per cent increase in fragrance sales. Beauty distribution revenue reached Rs 168 crore, up 59 per cent year-on-year. E-commerce sales, including omnichannel transactions, grew 12 per cent and contributed 14.2 per cent of revenue.

direction_reasons: fragrance is an input cost and is moving up
watch_next: fragrance over the next few weeks
RAVEL.why_it_matters: This reaches the company indirectly via its commodity exposure to fragrance. The parts of the business most likely touched are input cost. Classified as other.
